body:
The parked `perry-ext-streams` crate duplicates the stream implementation already provided by `perry-stdlib`, and its obsolete tests no longer compile. Remove the crate and its wrapper registration while retaining the canonical stdlib routing for Web Streams and Node streams.

This also removes its workspace, export-collision, handle and registry inventory entries, updates the associated documentation, and adds two routing regression tests. The registry extraction floor decreases by exactly the six deleted registries, preserving its existing margin. No version bump is included.

Closes #12390.

Validation reported by the cloud worker at `c9e720b17f959c0052819939bd1328c7a56fd415`:

- Fresh compiler, runtime-static and stdlib-static build passed.
- Both routing tests and all 33 serial stream tests passed.
- Three executable examples matched the saved Node reference output with auto-optimization disabled and enabled (six runs). The evidence manifest reports Node v24.19.0 while the worker reports the pinned v26.5.1 oracle; provenance is being checked and final validation will record the exact executable and version. Auto-optimized runs linked freshly rebuilt archives without prebuilt-archive fallback.
- Workspace, binding governance, lockfile, export and handle checks passed.
- Full lint was run: 28 failures reproduced on untouched upstream, and two were classified as environment failures. Full lint is not green; Linux validation does not establish macOS behavior.

The PR-numbered changelog is now present at head `1273aff03f8685e3d8a2f539dff9ac94088ac857`. Draft pending its matching compiler/archive rebuild, final acceptance checks, and resolution of the Node oracle provenance discrepancy. The validation above applies to the earlier code commit, not this new head.
title: Remove unused perry-ext-streams crate
head: cloud/issue-12390-remove-parked-streams
